name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.5: restock row state now reflects the flag the toggle actually controls. The stop-selling / enable-for-sale state was being read from Weimis isEnable (unwritable) instead of our kiosk disabledAisles, so toggling never appeared to stick and the dashboard disagreed with the kiosk (e.g. slot 22 shown sellable while the kiosk had it closed; slots 1-4 shown off while the kiosk was selling them). buildRsBays now takes disabledAisles from the layout response and marks isDisabled from it, with Weimis isEnable shown separately as an informational Weimi off badge. Cumulative over v6.0.4.
